title: Personal Hardship Assistance, Tropical Cyclone Alfred, March 2025 – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information for the Personal Hardship Assistance Grant following Tropical Cyclone Alfred.
intro: Service NSW on behalf of the NSW Reconstruction Authority are delivering emergency financial assistance support (the Grant) to households impacted by Tropical Cyclone Alfred. Individuals that were impacted by prolonged power outages or evacuation orders in the Local Government Areas of Ballina, Bellingen, Byron, Clarence Valley, Coffs Harbour, Dungog, Kempsey, Kyogle, Lismore, Lord Howe Island, MidCoast, Nambucca Valley, Port Macquarie-Hastings, Richmond Valley and Tweed are eligible to apply.
who_can_apply: Individuals impacted by prolonged power outages or evacuation orders in the Local Government Areas of Ballina, Bellingen, Byron, Clarence Valley, Coffs Harbour, Dungog, Kempsey, Kyogle, Lismore, Lord Howe Island, MidCoast, Nambucca Valley, Port Macquarie-Hastings, Richmond Valley and Tweed.
what_you_need: Evidence that you resided at an address located in the impacted area

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the Grant?
faqs.a: Individuals impacted by prolonged power outages or evacuation orders in the Local Government Areas of Ballina, Bellingen, Byron, Clarence Valley, Coffs Harbour, Dungog, Kempsey, Kyogle, Lismore, Lord Howe Island, MidCoast, Nambucca Valley, Port Macquarie-Hastings, Richmond Valley and Tweed are eligible.

Information collected includes your full name, date of birth, proof of identity document details, contact number and email address, residential address, evidence of residence in the impacted area, and bank details.

faqs.q: How will my information be used?
faqs.a: Your information will be used to process your application, pay the Grant, contact you about future supports, and conduct audits or investigations to ensure eligibility and financial integrity.
